g.text: DS1 HS20HS072RX, 2.0 inch 240 x 320 IPS, ST7789, write-only 4-wire SPI on SPI2:

g.desc: DS1 HS20HS072RX, 2.0 inch 240 x 320 IPS, ST7789, write-only 4-wire SPI on SPI2:

g.text: SCLK GPIO12, MOSI GPIO11, CS GPIO10, DC GPIO13, RST GPIO14. Start at 15 MHz.

g.desc: SCLK GPIO12, MOSI GPIO11, CS GPIO10, DC GPIO13, RST GPIO14. Start at 15 MHz.

g.text: J7 is a bottom-contact flip-lock connector. Its pad 1 is panel pin 1 (GND): the pad nearest the

g.desc: J7 is a bottom-contact flip-lock connector. Its pad 1 is panel pin 1 (GND): the pad nearest the

g.text: terminal-block edge, at y = 85.68 in the mechanical contract. The contacts of the tail are on the

g.desc: terminal-block edge, at y = 85.68 in the mechanical contract. The contacts of the tail are on the

g.text: display face; folded under the panel they face the board. Check both on a sample panel.

g.desc: display face; folded under the panel they face the board. Check both on a sample panel.

g.text: Backlight: four LEDs in parallel, about 3.0 V. R60 33R from V5 gives 59 mA at 24 VAC and 27 mA

g.desc: Backlight: four LEDs in parallel, about 3.0 V. R60 33R from V5 gives 59 mA at 24 VAC and 27 mA

g.text: at the lowest USB voltage. Q4 switches the cathode under PWM from GPIO21, 1 to 20 kHz.

g.desc: at the lowest USB voltage. Q4 switches the cathode under PWM from GPIO21, 1 to 20 kHz.

g.text: R62 holds Q4 off in reset. R63 holds RST high. C37 and C38 at J7 pins 8 and 9.

g.desc: R62 holds Q4 off in reset. R63 holds RST high. C37 and C38 at J7 pins 8 and 9.

g.text: LAYOUT: keep J7 within about 40 mm of module pins 18 to 22. TFT_BL keeps toggling when the

g.desc: LAYOUT: keep J7 within about 40 mm of module pins 18 to 22. TFT_BL keeps toggling when the

g.text: firmware hangs: it must never run next to KA (section 8.5).

g.desc: firmware hangs: it must never run next to KA (section 8.5).

g.text: DS1 is the panel itself. It has no footprint:

g.desc: DS1 is the panel itself. It has no footprint:

g.text: its 12-way tail plugs into J7 at final assembly.

g.desc: its 12-way tail plugs into J7 at final assembly.

g.text: Encoder and buttons: five contacts, active low

g.desc: Encoder and buttons: five contacts, active low

g.text: SW3 EC11J1525402: 30 detents, 15 pulses per turn, push switch.

g.desc: SW3 EC11J1525402: 30 detents, 15 pulses per turn, push switch.

g.text: SW4 Back and SW5 Manual / Home: 6 x 6 mm, 10 mm actuator.

g.desc: SW4 Back and SW5 Manual / Home: 6 x 6 mm, 10 mm actuator.

g.text: Each contact: 3.3k pull-up (1 mA, the encoder's minimum).

g.desc: Each contact: 3.3k pull-up (1 mA, the encoder's minimum).

g.text: Encoder phases A and B: then 10k and 100 nF, 1.0 ms

g.desc: Encoder phases A and B: then 10k and 100 nF, 1.0 ms

g.text: closing, 1.3 ms opening, for the pulse counter.

g.desc: closing, 1.3 ms opening, for the pulse counter.

g.text: The three push contacts have no filter. Firmware

g.desc: The three push contacts have no filter. Firmware

g.text: ENC_SW and BTN_HOME go straight to the pin.

g.desc: ENC_SW and BTN_HOME go straight to the pin.
